name: tandoor-recipes-mcp
description: Recipes, meal plans, shopping lists, ingredients, cook logs, nutrition and AI import for your local Tandoor instance.
long_description: Connects Claude to your local Tandoor Recipes instance. Search and edit recipes, plan meals, manage shopping lists and pantry inventory, log cooking, and import recipes with AI. Tool sections can be switched off, simple, or full in the extension settings.

tandoor_url.title: Tandoor URL
tandoor_url.description: Base URL of your Tandoor instance (e.g. https://tandoor.example.com)

tandoor_token.title: Tandoor API Token
tandoor_token.description: API token with write access. Create one at Settings → API Tokens in Tandoor.
